entities.name: Safe havens
entities.description: About 50 hidden identical caves and passages on Terisiare of unknown origin that certain wizards use to travel quickly.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: Continent where the safe havens lie.

entities.name: Rag Man
entities.description: Used the safe havens to bring Jodah to the Conclave of Mages.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Became one of the few who could activate the safe havens.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl
entities.description: Owner of keep Tresserhorn, Jodah's enemy.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: Triggered the safe haven's magic and enlisted Jodah for the World Spell.

entities.name: World Spell
entities.description: Spell whose effects were dispersed through the safe havens.

events.summary: The Rag Man used safe havens to bring Jodah quickly to the Conclave of Mages.
events.quote: the Rag Man used them to quickly bring Jodah from the coast of Terisiare to the Conclave of Mages

events.summary: Jaya rescued Jodah from Tresserhorn; when he collapsed Freyalise triggered the haven, transporting them to the coast.
events.quote: Jaya Ballard rescued Jodah from Lim-Dûl 's keep Tresserhorn

events.summary: Jodah activated all safe havens at once as vents for the World Spell, melting ice and igniting settlements within five miles.
events.quote: Jodah cast a spell to simultaneously activate all the safe havens at once

relations.quote: Jodah later used the safe havens actively during the war with Lim-Dûl.
